title: On the residual Eisenstein cohomology of unitary groups
summary: We investigate the residual Eisenstein cohomology of an arbitrary unitary group $U(V)$ attached to an arbitrary quadratic extension of number fields $E/F$. Our focus lies on the contribution of the maximal parabolic $F$-subgroups of $U(V)$, for which we identify the cohomologically relevant poles of Eisenstein series and prove that the resulting residues all survive as non-trivial classes in automorphic cohomology in an explicit degree.
